title: Validate price dimensions and sample quality
objective: Price previews state their scope and block invalid comparisons.
outcome: A gross charge, discounted cash price, negotiated amount and allowed amount remain different measures. Algorithm, percentage and per-diem values remain non-comparable. Missing or negative/zero values are investigated by documented semantics, not universally dropped or treated as valid prices. A passing sample does not imply legal compliance, complete hospital reporting or comparable patient costs. Current pinned CMS definitions are used, not an obsolete generic MRF schema. Ledger-named packages/identity/mrf/ is not used because identity is WP7-sealed. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Define comparable price context
commits.instructions: Require code system/version/modifiers, service setting, charge/rate type, payer/plan/network, unit, provider context and effective period as applicable.
commits.verification: A gross charge, discounted cash price, negotiated amount and allowed amount remain different measures.

commits.subject: Add quality and compatibility checks
commits.instructions: Flag missing required context, malformed dates, invalid values, duplicate exact rows and conflicting rates. Keep full-file validity separate from sampled checks.
commits.verification: Missing or negative/zero values are investigated by documented semantics, not universally dropped or treated as valid prices.

commits.subject: Produce sample-validation summaries
commits.instructions: Report parsed rows, checked fields, unresolved references, failed rules, byte scope and excluded comparisons. Preserve 2026 schema-specific field differences.
commits.verification: A passing sample does not imply legal compliance, complete hospital reporting or comparable patient costs.
